node.statement: For any explicit global-scalar, compressed-corner-scalar, Stage-1, Stage-2, or Stage-3 raw call into a recorded current corner A_R, assume A_R is an extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra and the literal output map u_R:B_R->A_R is an extended d_raw-inclusion (respectively isomorphism) from the raw call's named finite-dimensional C*-algebra source B_R. If d_raw <= delta_max^cb and epsilon_R <= epsilon_max^cb, then lem-maincb-error-improvement produces an error-improved map v_R:B_R->A_R satisfying d_R <= c_0^cb*epsilon_R, preserves bijectivity when u_R is bijective, and leaves the source, target corner R, and fixed amplification form unchanged.
